name: Road to Doomsday
description: Representative curated viewing guide preparing viewers for Avengers: Doomsday across four distinct narrative tiers.

entries.title: Avengers: Infinity War
entries.whyWatchThis: Establishes the cosmic stakes, catastrophic loss, and narrative scale necessary to understand the multiversal desperation.
keyPlotPoints: Thanos collects the Infinity Stones
The Blip eliminates 50% of all universal life

entries.title: Avengers: Endgame
entries.whyWatchThis: Introduces quantum time travel, branch timelines, and establishes the foundation for multiversal fracturing.
keyPlotPoints: Time Heist creates divergent alternate branch timelines
Tony Stark sacrifices himself using the Nano Gauntlet

entries.title: Loki
entries.whyWatchThis: Defines TVA mechanics, timeline branching, timeline death, and Loki's transformation into the multiversal anchor.
keyPlotPoints: Destruction of the Sacred Timeline threshold
Loki assumes the throne holding multiversal branches together

entries.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
entries.whyWatchThis: First major cinematic collision between multiple cinematic Marvel continuities and universes.
keyPlotPoints: Spell of Runes breakdown opens dimensional breaches
Convergence of legacy villains and Spider-Man variants

entries.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
entries.whyWatchThis: Explicitly introduces the concept and danger of Incursions — the collision and destruction of two universes.
keyPlotPoints: Dreamwalking corrupted by the Darkhold
Warning and demonstration of catastrophic multiversal Incursions

entries.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
entries.whyWatchThis: Introduces Anchor Beings and bridges the 20th Century Fox Marvel legacy continuity into the connected multiverse.
keyPlotPoints: Anchor Being mechanics and timeline decay
The Void and resistance survivors from pruned universes

entries.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
entries.whyWatchThis: Crucial character arcs for Steve Rogers, Bucky Barnes, and Sam Wilson forming the moral bedrock of Earth's defense.
keyPlotPoints: Collapse of S.H.I.E.L.D. from internal Hydra infiltration
Survival of Bucky Barnes as the Winter Soldier

entries.title: WandaVision
entries.whyWatchThis: Traces Wanda Maximoff's grief-fueled evolution into the mythical Scarlet Witch, setting up multiversal peril.
keyPlotPoints: Creation and dissipation of the Westview Hex
Wanda claims the mantle of Scarlet Witch and discovers the Darkhold

entries.title: The Avengers
entries.whyWatchThis: The genesis of Earth's Mightiest Heroes teaming up against extraterrestrial threats.
keyPlotPoints: Battle of New York unites the original six Avengers
First post-credits reveal of Thanos

entries.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
entries.whyWatchThis: Expands Marvel cosmic scope and provides lore regarding the origin and power of Infinity Stones.
keyPlotPoints: The Collector explains the ancient genesis of the Infinity Stones
The Power Stone is secured by the Nova Corps
